description: Search the Australia data.gov.au open data catalogue (CKAN) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "transport": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: Australia data.gov.au. License: open licence marks only — datasets filtered at the portal to CC BY / CC BY-SA / public-domain marks. Some datasets carry CC BY-SA marks — share-alike applies to derived works from those datasets.
